name: gemini-audio-mcp
description: High-performance audio generation MCP server for Gemini 2.5 and Lyria 3.
author: jxoesneon

tools.name: generate_soundscape
tools.description: Generates immersive environmental soundscapes using Gemini 2.0 Live.

tools.name: generate_voice
tools.description: Generates expressive speech and narration using Gemini 2.5 Native Audio.

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Generates full songs or loops via Lyria 3 (PAID).

tools.name: generate_sfx
tools.description: Generates short sound effects via Lyria 3 Clip.

tools.name: transition_soundscape
tools.description: Generates two soundscapes and crossfades between them.

tools.name: configure
tools.description: View or update persistent configuration and defaults.

tools.name: play_audio
tools.description: Plays an audio file using the system's default player.

tools.name: cleanup_assets
tools.description: Deletes generated audio files older than a specified age.

tools.name: check_dependencies
tools.description: Checks if external dependencies like FFmpeg are installed.
